programme.title: Fight For Life with Tony Granato: Craig Cunningham
programme.desc: Craig Cunningham's hockey career came to a sudden halt when he collapsed on the ice from cardiac arrest. Complications during his recovery led to the loss of his leg, forcing him to confront a future far different from the one he had always envisioned. In this episode of Fight for Life, Craig, his mother, and the doctorwho helped save his life reflect on the fight that changed everything.

programme.title: Fight For Life with Tony Granato: Eddie Olczyk
programme.desc: Eddie Olczyk's NHL career took off when he was still a teenager, leading to decades in the spotlight as a player and later as abroadcaster. But in 2017, his life was upended by a stage 3 colon cancer diagnosis. In this episode of Fight for Life, Eddie reflects on the highs of his hockey journey, the shock of his diagnosis, and the resilience it took to fight his way back - sharing how the experience reshaped his perspective on life, family, and purpose. His wife, Diana, joins the conversation, offering her perspective on the fight they faced together and the strength it took to support him every step of the way.
